# Anne Shirley & Minnie May

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Saved — [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) — since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> When [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) comes down with severe croup while her parents are away, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for help. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses her past experience with twins to nurse [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) through the night until [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brings a doctor, earning Mrs. Barry's gratitude and restoring [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Diana's friendship.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), with Matthew's help, to let her go to a [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night at Diana's house. After enjoying the concert and driving with Diana's cousins, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed only to leap on top of Diana's sleeping [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who becomes furious.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession
